notes.title: Minor patch - 2024/10/04
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the first "big boss" wouldn't provide any rewards
 Fixed a bug where loading the game after getting a warp core, wouldn't show the correct number gathered
 Fixed a bug where the game might trigger a game over condition on load
 Fixed an issue with 16:10 resolutions
 Added a note next to the modifications panel, so players know they can click on it to change modifiers active
